theater: 加薩走廊與以色列南部

battle.name: 以色列—哈馬斯戰爭
battle.theater: 加薩走廊與以色列南部
battle.brief: 二〇二三年十月七日哈馬斯以火箭彈與地道突襲攻擊以色列南部，以軍其後以海空封鎖加薩，並在十月二十七日投入地面攻勢。卡面是梅卡瓦四型主戰坦克：以軍裝甲旅與步兵師沿南北縱深線協同推進，此型坦克承擔正面突破、城市巷戰與反地道封鎖任務，是加薩走廊地面戰中最重要的裝甲骨幹。

kit.name: 梅卡瓦四型主戰坦克
kit.history: 梅卡瓦四型是以色列陸軍裝甲部隊的主力主戰坦克，位於地面作戰體系的裝甲核心，並承擔部隊防護與機動任務。

countries: 以色列國家與以色列國防軍是主要交戰方。國防軍由總參謀部統轄，戰時以南部戰區司令部負責加薩方向作戰，前線由加薩師、第162師等步兵師、裝甲旅、砲兵營與工程兵部隊組成，並由空軍、海軍及情報單位提供縱深支援。加薩方面由哈馬斯武裝組織主導，其前線單位是「卡桑旅」，下轄加薩城、漢尤尼斯、拉法等旅級部隊，巴勒斯坦聖戰組織亦在加薩境內配合行動；哈馬斯並非國家，但控制加薩地帶並主導地面防務。伊朗以彈道飛彈、無人機與技術支援介入，並於二〇二三年十月十四日直接向以色列發動大規模遠程攻擊；真主黨、胡塞武裝、伊拉克民兵與敘利亞方向武裝分別在北部、東部與西部形成牽制。美國提供防空攔截彈藥補給、軍艦與情報協助，英國與法國以海軍部署參與海上防衛，卡塔爾與埃及則在十一月推動暫停交戰與俘虜交換。
countriesEn: Israel and the Israel Defense Forces were the principal belligerents. The IDF is commanded by the General Staff; in this war the Southern Command directed operations toward Gaza, with the Gaza Division and formations such as the 162nd Division, armored brigades, artillery battalions and combat-engineer units holding the front line, supported in depth by the air force, the navy and intelligence units. On the Gaza side the Hamas armed organization led the fighting. Its field formation was the al-Qassam Brigades, organized into brigade-level units covering Gaza City, Khan Yunis and Rafah, with Palestinian Islamic Jihad operating alongside; Hamas is not a state, but it controlled the Gaza Strip and directed the principal ground defence. Iran supported the effort with ballistic missiles, drones and technical assistance, and on 14 October 2023 launched a large-scale long-range attack against Israel directly. Hezbollah, the Houthi movement, Iraqi militias and armed groups in Syria created pressure on the northern, eastern and western fronts. The United States supplied air-defence interceptor munitions, naval forces and intelligence support, while the United Kingdom and France contributed naval deployments for maritime defence, and Qatar and Egypt mediated a temporary cessation of hostilities and prisoner exchanges in November.
people: 人物必須分清政治責任、總參謀部與戰區指揮三層。以色列總理本雅明·內塔尼胡主持十月七日成立的戰時內閣；國防部長約奧夫·加蘭特在十月二十二日後由伊斯卡·卡茨接替。本尼·甘茨在開戰時任總參謀長，負責動員與統籌，十一月一日卸任，由原南部戰區司令赫茲·哈勒維接任總參謀長。加薩方面，哈馬斯政治局主席伊斯梅爾·哈尼亞負責政治領導，最高軍事責任歸於穆罕默德·戴夫；武裝部門「卡桑旅」參謀長葉海亞·薩拉吉是公開宣布攻勢並承認協調角色的人物，其前任伊茲·丁·卡桑已在十月二十一日陣亡。哈馬斯高層其後相繼在定點打擊中被清除，戴夫亦在二〇二四年七月被以軍宣稱擊斃；內塔尼胡與哈勒維在南部與加薩城方向多次下達圍剿與分割的命令。公開資料無法完整還原各營、連的即時指揮鏈，因此不把每支突擊分隊直接歸入最高指揮人員名下；開戰首日陣亡的以軍基層指揮官亦難逐一核實，只能按各營建制概括處理。
peopleEn: Political responsibility, the General Staff and theater command must be kept apart. Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu chaired the wartime cabinet formed on 7 October; defense minister Yoav Gallant was replaced by Israel Katz after 22 October. Benny Gantz was chief of staff at the outbreak of the war and directed mobilization and overall coordination until 1 November, when Herzi Halevi, previously commander of the Southern Command, took over the post. On the Gaza side, Hamas political bureau chairman Ismail Haniyeh led the political direction, while supreme military responsibility lay with Mohammed Deif; al-Qassam Brigades chief of staff Yahya Sarraj was the figure who publicly announced the offensive and acknowledged a coordinating role, and his predecessor Izz al-Din al-Qassam was killed on 21 October. Senior Hamas leaders were subsequently removed in targeted strikes, and Deif was declared killed by Israel in July 2024; Netanyahu and Halevi repeatedly ordered encirclement and partition operations in the south and toward Gaza City. Public records cannot reconstruct the real-time command chain of every battalion and company, so no specific assault detachment is attributed here to a supreme commander, and the Israeli junior commanders killed in the opening assault cannot each be verified individually, only treated generically by battalion establishment.
kits: 卡面兵器梅卡瓦四型主戰坦克於一九九〇年列裝，是以色列陸軍裝甲主力，在本場戰役中位於地面作戰體系的裝甲核心。它由梅卡瓦三型車體大幅改進而來，約重六十噸，乘員四人，裝德國MTU公司的千五百馬力柴油發動機，最大輸出約六百匹馬力，最高時速約八十公里；主炮為一二〇毫米滑膛炮，其後的四型M與四型M「巴茲」型改用一〇五毫米線膛炮，輔以七點六二毫米機槍與五點五六毫米班用步槍。防護方面配備「特羅菲」主動防護系統、雷射測距與熱成像觀瞄，並可加裝「刺針」與「鐵拳」反裝甲導彈發射器；車體前置推土鏟、側裙與煙幕發射器，專為城市巷戰設計，另有附加裝甲模組與履帶裙板。同一體系內以軍還有「卡爾」突擊步槍、大量美製裝甲車與「大力神」推土機、F-35I與F-15I戰鬥機、阿帕奇與武裝直升機、「箭三」與「大衛之弓」攔截系統、「鐵穹」防空系統，軍艦方面以「薩爾六」級巡防艦執行封鎖與護航。哈馬斯一方則大量使用改裝火箭炮、反坦克火箭筒與通用機槍，輔以縱橫交錯的地道網、突擊用快艇與民用改裝車輛。
kitsEn: The card's weapon, the Merkava IV main battle tank, entered Israeli Army service in 1990 and forms the armored core of the ground order of battle in this war. It is a heavily reworked development of the Merkava III hull, weighs about sixty tonnes, carries a crew of four, and mounts a German MTU diesel engine rated at 1,500 horsepower giving roughly six hundred horsepower and a top speed near eighty kilometres per hour. Its main gun is a 120 mm smoothbore on the Merkava IV, with the later Merkava IVM and Merkava IVM Baz variants reverting to a 105 mm rifled gun, and secondary armament comprising 7.62 mm machine guns and 5.56 mm squad weapons. Protection includes the Trophy active protection system, laser rangefinders and thermal sighting, and the vehicle can carry Spike and Iron Fist anti-tank guided missile launchers. A front dozer blade, side skirts and smoke grenade dischargers were fitted specifically for urban fighting, with additional appliqué armour modules and track skirts available. Within the same system Israel also fielded the Carbine rifle, large numbers of American-made armoured vehicles and Caterpillar D9 dozers, F-35I and F-15I fighters, Apache and attack helicopters, the Arrow 3 and David's Sling interceptor systems, the Iron Dome air-defence system, and Sa'ar 6-class corvettes for the blockade and escort duty. Hamas relied on heavily modified rocket launchers, anti-tank rocket tubes and general-purpose machine guns, supported by a lattice of tunnels, assault fast boats and improvised civilian vehicles.
tactics: 以色列的戰法分三段：先用海空封鎖與空襲削弱，再以裝甲步兵協同的地面攻勢奪取據點。地面部隊沿「薩利赫丁大道」與「拉希德大道」南北推進，裝甲旅與步兵師交替掩護，奪下路口後再向兩翼擴張。梅卡瓦四型按其「梅卡瓦式」戰術運作——坦克不冒進停在前線，而是倒車至後方，步兵由坦克兩側躍下進至車體前方，坦克以主炮與機槍提供壓制火力掩護步兵清剿，車體下方鋪設鋼板與即時防爆器材應付地雷與路障；坦克之間還互相覆蓋射界，以免被反坦克火箭從側面命中。對地道則由工程兵與突擊工程小組以定向爆破裝置連續摧毀隧道段，用推土機推平殘骸、灌入水泥封死洞口；海軍水下突擊隊與海陸協同小組負責清除海灘與碼頭工事，並以「鐵穹」與「大衛之弓」攔截火箭彈。哈馬斯採取縱深防禦與游擊式反擊：以火箭炮齊射與反坦克伏擊消耗敵裝甲，利用縱橫交錯的地道網轉移、儲存武器與設人質陷阱，派突擊隊以摩托車、快艇與滑翔翼滲透敵後，並於夜間實施狙擊與破壞任務。
tacticsEn: Israel's approach ran in three stages: first a naval and air blockade combined with strikes to degrade the enemy, then a ground offensive fought as combined arms to seize ground. Ground forces pushed north and south along the Saladin and al-Rashid avenues, with armored brigades and infantry divisions taking turns in support, securing junctions before widening the front. The Merkava IV was employed according to the Merkava-style doctrine: the tank does not advance alone to the front but reverses to a rear position, the dismounted infantry jumps down from either flank and moves ahead of the hull, and the tank provides suppressing fire with main gun and machine gun to cover the infantry's clearance of the position; armor plate and improvised explosive devices are laid beneath the hull to cope with mines and roadblocks, and tanks cover one another's firing sectors so that anti-tank teams cannot engage them from the flank. Tunnels were destroyed by combat engineers and assault-engineering detachments using shaped demolition charges against successive tunnel sections, with dozers levelling the debris and concrete poured to seal the entrances. Naval underwater commandos and joint maritime-landing detachments cleared beach and port positions, while Iron Dome and David's Sling intercepted incoming rockets. Hamas adopted defense in depth and hit-and-run counterattack: rocket salvos and anti-tank ambushes to wear down enemy armor, a lattice of tunnels for movement, weapons storage and hostage holding, infiltration detachments using motorcycles, fast boats and paragliders, and night sniper and sabotage missions.
data: 可核實的數字集中在幾個節點：二〇二三年十月七日，哈馬斯在約二十分鐘內向以色列境內發射三千至五千枚火箭，當晚再發射約一百五十枚，同時以約三千人的突擊分隊循陸路、隧道與海路滲透。以軍在十月二十七日發動地面進攻前已集結逾十萬兵力的入侵部隊，並在開戰首日宣佈進入戰爭狀態，頭二十日每日空襲約三百五十次。加薩走廊全長約四十公里，寬度北部約十二公里、南部收窄至六公里左右，面積約三百六十五平方公里，境內人口約二百三十萬。梅卡瓦四型約重六十噸、乘員四人、裝千五百馬力發動機，主炮一二〇毫米，另有主動防護與反裝甲導彈。十一月十九日起的卡塔爾斡旋下，十一月三十日一次交換釋出八名在加薩被扣押的以方人員與三十名被羈押的巴勒斯坦人，並延長一日停火，該輪暫停戰鬥於十二月一日屆滿。地面階段以軍先後投入多個步兵師與裝甲旅，一支步兵營曾於二〇二四年八月底自漢尤尼斯與代爾拜萊赫地區撤出，以軍宣稱該次行動擊斃逾二百五十名武裝人員。攔截彈與重彈藥在首年即被大量消耗，美軍以「鐵穹」「大衛之弓」與「薩德」組件緊急輸送，並承擔了這場戰爭約七成的開支。傷亡與俘虜總數各方說法不一、統計口徑分歧，本段不列精確總數。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around a few nodes. On 7 October 2023 Hamas fired between three thousand and five thousand rockets into Israel in roughly twenty minutes, with about one hundred and fifty more that evening, while an assault force of some three thousand men infiltrated by land, through tunnels and by sea. Before the ground incursion of 27 October Israel had assembled an invasion force of more than one hundred thousand troops, and it declared a state of war on the first day, flying on average around three hundred and fifty sorties per day during the opening twenty days. The Gaza Strip is about forty kilometres long, roughly twelve kilometres wide in the north and narrowing to about six kilometres in the south, with an area near 365 square kilometres and a population of about 2.3 million. The Merkava IV weighs approximately sixty tonnes, carries four crew and mounts a 1,500 horsepower engine with a 120 mm main gun, plus active protection and anti-tank guided missiles. Under the Qatari-brokered pause that began on 19 November, a 30 November exchange released eight Israeli captives held in Gaza in return for thirty Palestinians in Israeli custody and extended the truce by a day, and that round of fighting stopped on 1 December. During the ground phase Israel committed several infantry divisions and armored brigades in turn, and one infantry battalion withdrew from the Khan Yunis and Deir al-Balah area at the end of August 2024, the Israeli side stating it had killed more than two hundred and fifty armed personnel there. Interceptor and heavy munitions stocks were heavily drained in the first year, with the United States rushing components for Iron Dome, David's Sling and THAAD and funding about seventy per cent of the war's cost. Total casualty and prisoner figures remain disputed between the parties and the counting conventions differ, so no exact totals are given here.
cause: 這場戰爭是二〇二三年十月七日「阿克薩洪水行動」引爆的跨境戰爭，背景可溯數十年。一九四八年建國與巴勒斯坦難民的流離、二〇六七年以色列佔領約旦河西岸，以及一九八七年哈馬斯成立並在一九九〇年代把「消滅以色列」寫入憲章，構成武裝對抗的思想源頭；一九八七年起加薩歸哈馬斯掌控，二〇〇七年以軍實施封鎖，造成結構性的封閉，其後二〇〇八至二〇〇九、二〇一二、二〇一四與二〇二一年四輪衝突，累積傷亡並留下俘虜與拘押的未解難題。外部層面，二〇二〇年《亞伯拉罕協議》推動以色列與阿拉伯國家正常化的「列車」令哈馬斯領導層視之為首要威脅；同時二〇二三年七至九月以軍在約旦河西岸城鎮的行動與亞述聖殿廣場事件升高火藥味。據多方說法，哈馬斯自二〇二一年起即在策劃針對以色列的大規模行動，目標包括造成最大傷亡、擄獲人質作為談判籌碼，並攔截正常化進程；十月七日清晨哈馬斯武裝先以武力和突襲控制邊境通道，再以火箭彈齊射展開全面攻擊，以色列遂宣布進入戰爭狀態。
causeEn: This war was triggered by the cross-border Al-Aqsa Flood operation of 7 October 2023, and its background runs back several decades. The creation of Israel in 1948 and the flight of Palestinian refugees, the Israeli occupation of the West Bank after 1967, and the founding of Hamas in 1987 with destroying Israel written into its charter in the 1990s form the ideological root of the armed confrontation. Hamas took control of Gaza in 1987, and the Israeli blockade from 2007 produced a structural closure; four earlier rounds — 2008-09, 2012, 2014 and 2021 — added casualties and left hostage and detention questions unresolved. On the external side, the normalization train of the Abraham Accords in 2020 was treated by the Hamas leadership as the priority threat; meanwhile Israeli operations in West Bank towns between July and September 2023 and the raid on the Al-Aqsa compound raised the temperature. According to several accounts Hamas had been planning a large operation against Israel from 2021 onward, aiming to inflict maximum casualties, seize hostages as negotiating leverage and interrupt the normalization process; on the morning of 7 October its armed wing first seized the border crossings by force, then opened the general assault with a rocket barrage, and Israel declared a state of war in response.
impact: 影響沿三條線擴散。第一是戰區層面：以軍的封鎖與地面攻勢把加薩分割為南北兩部，哈馬斯旅級打擊力量大量被摧毀，高層指揮官相繼陣亡，二〇二四年五月拉法攻勢、二〇二五年加薩城攻勢之後，加薩北部與中部由以軍重兵控制；但戰事未以任何一方的政治目標收束，至二〇二六年仍在延續。二〇二三年十月起真主黨在北部邊境開火、胡塞武裝自十一月起攻擊紅海商船、伊拉克民兵與敘利亞方向武裝相繼升級，伊朗於十月十四日直接發射彈道飛彈，二〇二五年更演變為多線區域戰爭，直接推高以色列與美國的海空部署強度，紅海航線亦因此改道。第二是軍備與工業層面：攔截彈、炸藥與重砲彈存量被迅速抽空，美軍以「鐵穹」「大衛之弓」與「薩德」組件緊急輸送、美國承擔了這場戰爭約七成的開支，以色列並自美方駐境庫存直接補充；戰後以軍加速「梅卡瓦四型M」與裝甲車的生產改裝，把對地攻擊、隧道戰與無人化作為新一代裝甲部隊的訓練重點。第三是法律與政治層面：國際刑事法院受理的案件與聯合國調查委員會的結論，連同各地示威與反猶言論升溫，使這場衝突由區域戰爭變成國際法的持久爭議。
impactEn: The effects ran along three lines. First, in the theater: the blockade and ground offensive split Gaza into a southern and a northern half, much of the Hamas brigade strike structure was destroyed, and senior commanders were killed in succession; after the Rafah offensive from May 2024 and the Gaza City offensive of 2025, the north and center of Gaza came under sustained Israeli control, yet the war was not closed out on any side's political objectives and was still running in 2026. From October 2023 Hezbollah opened fire on the northern border, the Houthi movement began attacking Red Sea shipping from November, Iraqi militias and groups in Syria escalated in turn, and Iran launched ballistic missiles directly on 14 October 2023, a line that developed into a multi-front regional war in 2025, pushing up the intensity of Israeli and American sea and air deployments and diverting Red Sea shipping. Second, in the industrial and equipment field: interceptor, explosive and heavy shell stocks were rapidly drained, the United States rushed components for Iron Dome, David's Sling and THAAD, funded about seventy per cent of the war's cost, and Israel drew directly on American stockpiles in the country; after the war Israel accelerated production and modification of the Merkava IVM and armored vehicles, and made direct-fire, tunnel-fighting and unmanned operations the focus of armored training. Third, in the legal and political field: cases before the International Court of Justice and the findings of the United Nations Commission of Inquiry, together with mass demonstrations worldwide and a surge of antisemitism, turned a regional war into a lasting international legal dispute.
result: 就二〇二三年的第一階段而言，結果是雙方都沒有取得決定性勝利：哈馬斯的突襲造成以軍建制折損並擄獲大量人員，但以軍隨即以絕對空海優勢封鎖加薩、投入逾十萬兵力完成地面進攻，在北部、漢尤尼斯、拉法等方向逐區清剿，摧毀大部分旅級打擊力量；十一月十九日起的停火窗口則在有限度交換人質與被拘押者後於十二月一日破裂，加薩南部仍有成建制武裝力量抵抗。往後的走向顯示戰爭變成長期消耗：二〇二四年五月拉法攻勢後哈馬斯高層相繼被清除，二〇二五年一月停火、二〇二五年三月再度破裂、二〇二五年十月在美國方案下達成第三次停火，隨後哈馬斯民政當局於二〇二六年七月辭職，武裝組織並在七月三十一日同意在重建與以軍撤退的條件下解除武裝。整體而言，以色列保住了國土與主要軍事主權並長期控制加薩大部分地區，哈馬斯的軍事建制遭重創但未被徹底消滅，俘虜問題成為最難解的政治結；戰爭至二〇二六年仍在加薩境內以低強度衝突與停火交替的形式延續，雙方都未宣布勝利。
resultEn: For the first phase of 2023, the result was that neither side achieved a decisive victory. The Hamas assault inflicted losses on the Israeli order of battle and took large numbers of personnel captive, but Israel immediately sealed Gaza with overwhelming air and sea superiority, committed more than one hundred thousand troops to the ground offensive, and methodically cleared the north, Khan Yunis and Rafah, destroying most of the brigade-level strike formations; the truce window that opened on 19 November exchanged a limited number of hostages and detainees before collapsing on 1 December, and organized armed resistance continued in southern Gaza. The later course shows a war of long attrition: after the Rafah offensive from May 2024 the Hamas leadership was progressively removed; the January 2025 ceasefire broke down in March 2025; a third ceasefire was reached in October 2025 under the American plan, after which the Hamas civil administration resigned in July 2026 and the armed organizations agreed on 31 July to disarm in return for reconstruction progress and an Israeli withdrawal. Overall, Israel preserved its territory and military sovereignty and has long controlled most of Gaza; the Hamas military structure was gutted but not eliminated; the hostage question became the hardest political knot to untie; and as of 2026 the war continues inside Gaza in an alternation of low-intensity contact and ceasefire, with neither side declaring victory.
